title: ACadSharp Prototype_1b schema-value comparator caveat
mode: deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
scope: Recheck the exact released ACadSharp DataStorage comparator role against current upstream defect evidence
Separate structured DWG Prototype_1b parsing from schema-value fidelity, DXF ACDSDATA extraction, writing, and ACIS semantics
Tighten the optional PAR-07/S8 comparator capture requirements without adding a required dependency

sources.observed: The PR author reports that DwgPrototype1bReader.readSchemaProperty sizes the value array by PropertyValueCount but repeatedly fills row zero, losing later values. The PR text identifies AcDbDs::ID as a common two-value property. A one-line reader fix remains proposed; the regression test was removed during review because of a planned refactor. The PR remains open and undeployed at review time.
sources.limits: The report concerns ACadSharp's peer implementation, is not reproduced locally, and does not prove a defect in libdxfrw or establish whether every peer lookup route depends on the affected property values.

sources.revision: v3.7.1 tag commit d7dc111; PR #1154 is included in the released structured DWG Prototype_1b reader lineage
sources.observed: The discussion distinguishes earlier scan/fallback extraction from the subsequently merged structured DWG reader. The contributor states the DXF extraction logic remains on its earlier path; the discussion also records concerns about general writer assumptions and blob/schema coverage.
sources.limits: Issue discussion and contributor statements are not an independent reproduction of a peer defect. A structured DWG reader does not prove DXF carrier parity, writer fidelity, B-rep semantics, independent-kernel validity, or native CAD acceptance.

sources.project: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sources.observed: ODA documents schema-index references, schema property values and counts, and schema-search data relationships; it notes schema-search data can be ignored by readers.
sources.limits: The specification is the byte-layout authority, not an endorsement of a peer API and not a semantic ACIS/B-rep specification.

decision.planDelta: ACadSharp v3.7.1 remains an optional structural DWG Prototype_1b comparator but is no longer treated as an unqualified typed schema-value oracle. Any selected run must capture all multi-valued schema property rows, compare AcDbDs::ID values against the independent raw DataIndex/record/entity/owner ledger, and keep DXF ACDSDATA, writer, ACIS semantics, kernel, and native evidence separate.

implementationReadyChecks: For a pinned optional ACadSharp run, use an exact schema property with PropertyValueCount greater than one and preserve every raw value row in the evidence capture.
Resolve records from the ODA-led DataIndex -> record-header handle -> entity/owner mapping before consulting any schema/search convenience API.
Treat absent or inconsistent ACadSharp high-level schema results as a peer limitation unless an independently parsed raw-ledger mismatch demonstrates a local error.
Do not promote this peer to a DXF ACDSDATA, writer, ACIS geometry, independent kernel, or native consumer authority.

validation.commitBlocker: No commit attempted; shared worktree has extensive unrelated user changes and Git metadata is read-only in this environment.
